description: Transports en commun à Toulouse entre 1863 et 1957-Terminus is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Toulouse. Traces of the different modes of public transport (terminus) common to Toulouse between 1863 and 1957. From the time of the Omnibuses from 1863 to 1882, the electrification of the grid and until the peak of the electricity grid in 1934. The dataset contains 5 plots and 5 tables containing the points of the stations. Coverage: Mairie de Toulouse. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport in Toulouse between 1863 and 1957-Terminus" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mairie de Toulouse. Its keywords include reseau, public, transport, station, patrimoine, historique. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2024-12-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
